name: looks_like
description: What holding one side of a trade-off looks like.

aiGuidance.purpose: What it looks like in practice to lean on this side (public word: side; the record is a pole).
aiGuidance.extraction: One plain-English sentence in the third person (a team, a person, a document); rewrite first-person source text.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not use first person, mystical or elemental terms, or praise the side over its opposite; both sides are legitimate.
